description: This source file defines data structures related to skills management, including status reporting, requirements, missing components, configuration checks, installation options, and update results. It is part of a larger application handling skills in an OpenClaw project.

classes.name: SkillStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a specific skill with various attributes including name, description, source, and compatibility details.

classes.name: SkillRequirements
classes.description: Contains required binaries, environment variables, and configuration for a skill.

classes.name: SkillMissing
classes.description: Details missing components for a skill, such as absent binaries, environment variables, or configs.

classes.name: SkillStatusConfigCheck
classes.description: Represents a configuration check for a skill, indicating if the check is satisfied.

classes.name: SkillInstallOption
classes.description: Defines options available for installing or updating a skill.

classes.name: SkillsStatusReport
classes.description: Encapsulates the overall status report for multiple skills within the workspace.

classes.name: SkillInstallResult
classes.description: Provides the result of a skill installation operation, including success, messages, and process output.

classes.name: SkillUpdateResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of a skill update attempt, including success status and relevant details.
